mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 41 degrees with fog near Verona City Hall and a Waxing Gibbous moon visible. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is planning for the future by expanding the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our population, while construction on Mark Drive and Legion Street continues to improve our local infrastructure.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and various trivia events happening at local spots next week.
On November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle for a domestic disturbance that resulted in a 48-year-old man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Please note that Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
